chapters.title: Number System
chapters.shortIntro: CMAT: Number System — exam preparation guide.

introduction.overview:
Number System is a critical topic for the CMAT examination. This chapter covers the complete syllabus content as specified by the conducting body, with focus on the types of questions that appear in the entrance test.

The CMAT is one of the most competitive entrance examinations in Nepal, and thorough preparation of Number System is essential for achieving a high rank. Past papers analysis shows that this topic consistently carries significant marks.

Students should combine systematic study with timed practice tests. Focus on accuracy first, then work on speed. Understanding concepts deeply is more effective than memorizing formulas, as the examination tests analytical ability.

A structured preparation plan covering this chapter, combined with regular revision and mock tests, will maximize your chances of success in the CMAT.
introduction.whyItMatters: High-frequency topic in CMAT. Thorough preparation of Number System can significantly improve your entrance rank. Multiple questions appear from this chapter every year.

topics.name: Core Concepts: Number System
topics.explanation:
This topic covers the essential concepts of Number System that are tested in the CMAT examination. Focus is on building a solid understanding that enables quick and accurate problem-solving under exam conditions.

Students should practice with past entrance papers and model questions to familiarize themselves with the question patterns.
topics.examTip: In CMAT, time management is crucial. Practice solving MCQs within 60-90 seconds per question.

topics.name: Problem Solving: Number System
topics.explanation:
Advanced problem-solving techniques for Number System in the context of competitive entrance examination. This topic covers shortcuts, elimination strategies, and advanced methods.

Focus on the most frequently tested areas and develop systematic approaches to solve problems efficiently.
topics.examTip: Review the last 5 years of CMAT papers for Number System. Identify the most repeated question types.
